items.title: China Seminar Gives Fatu Network Reporter Fresh Vision for Gambia’s Ecotourism
items.summary: Written by: Dawda Baldeh The Fatu Network Senior Reporter Alieu Jallow has completed a two-week international seminar on Ecological Governance and Ecotourism Development for Belt and Road Countries in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China, returning to The Gambia with new ideas on ...
